character.name: Moon Astronaut
character.description: tiny cheerful astronaut in a rounded ivory spacesuit with orange accents and a glossy blue visor, actively gripping a golden crescent moon with both gloved hands, boots tucked up, the crescent has a small decorative loop for the upper cord

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
